english translation text: THE ONLY HOPE FOR ZAHRA’S DAUGHTERS IS GHAZI (HAZRAT ABBAS A.S.)

arabic text: ZAHRA JAIYAN DA AASRA GHAZI,\nHOYA KARBAL, DHE VICH JUDA GHAZI
english translation text: THE ONLY HOPE FOR ZAHRA’S DAUGHTERS IS GHAZI (HAZRAT ABBAS A.S.),\nIN KERBALA THEY WERE SEPARATED FROM GHAZI

arabic text: KEEWE JAAWANGI SHAAM TE KUFA\nMEKU MAHMAL TE AH BAHA GHAZI
english translation text: HOW WILL I MAKE MY WAY TO SHAAM & KUFA,\nOH COME AND HELP ME SIT ON THE SADDLE O’GHAZI

arabic text: AJVI BINTE HUSSAIN RONDI EH\nHATH MERE QAID TU CHURA GHAZI
english translation text: TILL TODAY DAUGHTER OF HUSSAIN MOURNS,\nOH COME AND BAIL ME OUT OF THIS PRISON O’GHAZI

arabic text: SIR TU ZAINAB DE LEH GAYI CHADAR\nJADUN MAQTAL NU TUR PAYA GHAZI
english translation text: THEY TOOK VEIL OF ZAINAB FROM HER HEAD,\nTHE MOMENT YOU LEFT FOR THE BATTLEFIELD O’GHAZI

arabic text: MERI CHADAR KHUDA DA PARDA EH\nMERI CHADAR DI TU BAQA GHAZI
english translation text: MY VEIL IS THE CLOAK OF ALLAH,\nYOU O’GHAZI ARE THE PRESTIGE OF MY VEIL

arabic text: CHEH JAGA TOUN HUSSAIN CHUNEYA HAI\nFIR VI PURA NA MIL SAKA GHAZI
english translation text: HUSSAIN TRIED TO GATHER YOUR SHATTERED PIECES FROM DIFFERENT PLACES,\nHE WAS NOT ABLE TO FIND ALL THE PIECES OF YOUR BODY O’GHAZI

arabic text: SHIMR RAJ RAJ HUSSAIN TU MAARE\nJAAN DA EH NAHI REYA GHAZI
english translation text: SHIMR HITS HUSSAIN WITH SUCH FORCE,\nAS HE KNEW YOU AREN’T THERE TO SAVE HIM O’GHAZI
